Več informacij o izpolnjevanju posameznega pogoja je na voljo v rubriki »Pojasnila« na dnu objave. V Elektronski Prijavi Mora Kandidat Navesti, Da Izpolnjuje pogoj glede predpisane izobrazbe, iz katere mora biti razvidna raven in smer izobrazbe, ter leto in ustanova, na kateri je bila izobrazba pridobljena; pogoj glede delovnih izkušenj, iz katerih je razvidno izpolnjevanje pogoja glede predpisanih delovnih izkušenj z opredelitvijo časa opravljanja dela in zahtevnosti dela glede na raven izobrazbe, ki se zahteva za opravljanje tega dela; vse ostale pogoje za razpisano delovno mesto. Postopek prijave in izbire Prijavo na javni natečaj kandidat odda v elektronski obliki preko portala eUprava, in sicer z uporabo spletnega obrazca, do katerega dostopa s klikom na gumb »e-Prijava na delovno mesto«, ki se nahaja na desni strani (na mobilnih napravah na dnu strani). Če kandidat prijave ne odda preko portala eUprava, se šteje, da ta ni bila vložena. Vloga mora biti popolna, saj se kandidatov k dopolnitvi prijave ne poziva. Prijavo je treba oddati najkasneje do 5. 12. 2026. Kandidati, ki oddajo pravočasno in popolno prijavo ter na podlagi prijave izkazujejo izpolnjevanje natečajnih pogojev, se uvrstijo v izbirni postopek. Kandidati, ki se ne uvrstijo v izbirni postopek, o tem prejmejo sklep. Izbirni postopek se izvaja v dveh delih. Prvi del izvaja Center za kadre, kjer kandidati opravljajo pisni preizkus osnovnega poznavanja državne ureditve in ureditve lokalne samouprave Republike Slovenije ter presojo temeljnih osebnih sposobnosti in veščin za opravljanje dela. Uspešni kandidati izbirni postopek nadaljujejo pri organu, ki je razpisal javni natečaj. Izbirni postopek pri organu lahko poteka v več fazah, v katerih se uporabljajo različne metode preverjanja strokovno usposobljenosti, kot sta na primer pisni preizkus in ustni razgovor. O ne(izbiri) kandidati prejmejo sklep. Zahtevane delovne izkušnje se skrajšajo za tretjino v primeru, da ima kandidat univerzitetno izobrazbo ali visoko strokovno izobrazbo s specializacijo oziroma magisterijem znanosti (prejšnjim) ali magistrsko izobrazbo (druga bolonjska stopnja). Zahtevane delovne izkušnje se skrajšajo za tretjino v primeru, da ima kandidat zaključen specialistični študij, magisterij znanosti ali doktorat znanosti, ter za eno leto v primeru, da ima kandidat opravljen pravniški državni izpit ali pravosodni izpit. review_candidates.description: Job Description Superintendent, Foundation Field Operations Department: Project Services Reports To: Senior Manager, Foundation Field Operations Location: Flexible / Field-Based Company Overview NextPower is a leading provider of innovative solar installation solutions and high-performance tooling designed for large-scale renewable energy projects. Our mission is to empower our customers with reliable tools, exceptional support, and industry-leading expertise that drive efficiency and safety on every job site. With a commitment to continuous improvement, customer success, and operational excellence, NextPower continues to expand its footprint across renewable energy and infrastructure markets. Position Summary The Superintendent, Foundation Field Operations is responsible for leading field maintenance and fleet support operations across assigned project sites, ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of NextPower Foundations' specialized drilling equipment, support fleet, and foundation construction assets. This position serves as the primary field leader for maintenance personnel, inventory personnel, and maintenance activities while supporting project execution through equipment reliability, technician development, and operational excellence. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Foundation Field Operations , the Superintendent oversees daily maintenance operations, manages field maintenance teams, coordinates preventative maintenance programs, supports equipment commissioning and deployment, and ensures compliance with company safety, environmental, and operational standards. The Superintendent provides leadership to Field Mechanic III, Field Mechanic II, and Field Mechanic I personnel , with Field Mechanic III employees serving as lead technicians within their assigned projects. Key Responsibilities Field Operations Leadership Lead and supervise field maintenance personnel across multiple project locations. Provide direction, coaching, accountability, and performance management for Field Mechanic III, Field Mechanic II, Field Mechanic I, and support maintenance staff. Coordinate daily maintenance priorities to ensure fleet readiness and support project production schedules. Partner with project leadership to align equipment availability with operational demands. Support staffing plans, onboarding, workforce development, and technician retention initiatives. Foster a culture of accountability, professionalism, teamwork, and customer service. Fleet Maintenance & Equipment Reliability Ensure execution of preventive maintenance programs, inspections, corrective repairs, equipment transfers, commissioning, and decommissioning activities. Monitor equipment utilization, condition, downtime, maintenance compliance, and repair status across assigned projects. Review recurring failures and equipment performance trends and develop corrective action plans. Support troubleshooting and escalation of complex hydraulic, mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, diesel, and automated control system issues. Coordinate with Engineering, vendors, Fleet Maintenance Center personnel, and operational stakeholders to resolve technical issues. Verify maintenance standards, repair quality, and operational readiness of fleet assets. Remove unsafe or unserviceable equipment from operation when required and facilitate corrective actions. Maintenance Planning & Documentation Ensure all maintenance activities are properly documented within MaintainX or approved CMMS platforms. Review work orders, inspections, labor entries, parts usage, and repair records for accuracy and completeness. Monitor preventive maintenance compliance and overdue service requirements. Maintain accurate records supporting regulatory compliance, fleet analytics, equipment history, and performance reporting. Develop and communicate maintenance schedules and fleet readiness reports to leadership. Safety & Compliance Promote and enforce all OSHA, DOT, environmental, customer, and company safety requirements. Conduct routine safety observations, audits, inspections, and follow-up corrective actions. Ensure Field Mechanic I, Field Mechanic II, and Field Mechanic III personnel follow approved maintenance procedures, lockout/tagout requirements, and safe work practices. Participate in incident investigations, root cause analysis, and implementation of corrective actions. Maintain compliance with project-specific and regulatory maintenance requirements. Inventory, Parts & Vendor Coordination Coordinate with Inventory Specialists to ensure adequate stock of critical spare parts, tools, consumables, and maintenance materials. Monitor inventory levels and communicate shortages through established escalation channels. Support management of vendor relationships, equipment manufacturers, service providers, and labor partners. Assist in procurement planning, equipment mobilization, and asset deployment activities. Team Development Mentor and develop Field Mechanic I, Field Mechanic II, and Field Mechanic III personnel through training, coaching, performance feedback, field evaluations, and career development planning. Support technical development programs focused on diagnostic skills, preventive maintenance, safety, and equipment operation. Identify future leaders and assist with succession planning efforts. Promote standardization of maintenance practices throughout the organization. Required Experience & Qualifications Minimum 10 years of experience maintaining and repairing heavy equipment, drilling equipment, construction machinery, or similar industrial equipment. Minimum 5 years of leadership experience supervising maintenance personnel, field service teams, or fleet operations. Demonstrated experience managing maintenance activities across multiple construction projects or geographic regions. Advanced knowledge of: Diesel engines Hydraulic systems Electrical systems Pneumatic systems Mechanical drive systems Electronic controls and machine automation systems Experience utilizing CMMS platforms, maintenance tracking software, and equipment diagnostics systems. Strong understanding of equipment reliability programs, preventive maintenance, and root cause failure analysis. Valid driver's license and ability to travel extensively. Preferred Experience supporting deep foundation, solar, renewable energy, heavy civil, utility, or infrastructure construction operations. Technical certification, trade school training, military technical training, or apprenticeship completion. ASE, OEM, or related technical certifications. OSHA 30 certification. Experience with telematics systems, fleet analytics, and maintenance reporting platforms. Familiarity with Caterpillar, Bauer, Liebherr, Soilmec, Manitowoc, and similar foundation construction equipment. Key Competencies Safety Leadership Fleet Reliability Management Team Leadership & Development Operational Excellence Maintenance Planning Equipment Diagnostics & Troubleshooting Root Cause Analysis Change Management Communication & Stakeholder Management Customer Focus Problem Solving & Decision Making Budget & Resource Management Continuous Improvement Reporting Structure Reports To Senior Manager, Foundation Field Operations Direct Reports May Include Field Mechanic III (Lead Field Mechanics) Field Mechanic II Field Mechanic I Inventory Specialists Contract Maintenance Personnel Field Mechanic III personnel function as senior technical resources and field leads, reporting directly to the Superintendent while providing day-to-day technical guidance and mentoring to Field Mechanic II and Field Mechanic I personnel. Physical Requirements Ability to work at active construction and industrial project sites. Ability to walk on uneven terrain and perform site inspections. Ability to lift, climb, bend, and work around heavy equipment. Ability to work outdoors in varied weather conditions. Frequent travel throughout North America and other project locations as required. Success in This Role Will Be Measured By Equipment uptime and fleet availability Preventive maintenance compliance Reduction in unplanned downtime Safety performance and incident reduction Technician development and retention Maintenance documentation quality Fleet readiness for project operations Cost-effective maintenance execution Customer and project support satisfaction At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure. Nextpower is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are Nextpower

review_candidates.title: Sponsor dedicated CRA Belgium
review_candidates.description: Description Sponsor dedicated CRA Belgium Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress. Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape. Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need. Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know: Why Syneos Health We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program. We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life. We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress. Job Responsibilities For one of our single sponsor partnerships we are looking for an experienced CRA to join the team here in Belgium. Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practices (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes. Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues. Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP):Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete via review of site source documents and medical records Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements. May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned. Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations. Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and action items to resolution. Understands project scope, budgets, and timelines for own and others’ activities in the clinical team; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets. May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements. Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in and may lead global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements. Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions. May provide direct supervision, training and/or mentorship to more junior level CRAs. Performs training and sign off visits for junior CRA staff, as assigned. May be mentored and assigned lead tasks under supervision of an experienced Clinical Operations Lead (COL) or operational line manager. This could include participation in business development proposals and/or defense meetings. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements Previous monitoring experience in Belgium Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills. Moderate level of critical thinking skills expected. Fluent in both Dutch and French Ability to manage required travel for monitoring visits. Get to know Syneos Health Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients. No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health. http://www.syneoshealth.com Additional Information Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job. Summary Roles within Clinical Monitoring/CRA job family are responsible for monitoring during clinical research studies to ensure that the trials are being conducted in accordance with widely accepted clinical practices. This includes conducting on-site and remote monitoring, developing tools, procedures, and processes to ensure quality monitoring. Impact and Contribution Individual contributors with responsibility in a professional or technical discipline or specialty, but may manage two or fewer employees. May direct the work of lower level professionals or manage processes and programs. The majority of time is spent contributing to the design, implementation or delivery of processes, programs, and policies, using knowledge and skills typically acquired through advanced education. Individual contributor with developing subject matter expertise and responsibility for processes. In-depth knowledge and skills within a professional discipline, understanding the impact of work on related areas. May be responsible for entire projects or processes within area of responsibility.

review_candidates.title: Special Project Engineer | MTerra Solar
review_candidates.description: The Special Project Engineer will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing special engineering projects and improvement initiatives within the Company's solar power generation facility. The role involves managing project requirements, developing technical scopes, coordinating engineering works, monitoring project implementation, and ensuring the successful completion of projects in accordance with approved specifications, schedules, budgets, quality standards, and safety requirements. The position will support plant improvement projects, equipment upgrades, system modifications, technical enhancements, and other engineering initiatives aimed at improving operational efficiency, reliability, safety, and overall asset performance. The role will work closely with the Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Procurement, Project Management, and other relevant teams, as well as external contractors and service providers. Key Responsibilities Special Project Planning and Development Identify, evaluate, and develop engineering project proposals and improvement initiatives based on operational requirements and identified plant needs. Conduct preliminary technical assessments, site inspections, and feasibility evaluations to determine project requirements and implementation considerations. Develop project scopes, technical specifications, cost estimates, resource requirements, and implementation schedules. Prepare project plans and execution strategies aligned with operational priorities and approved business objectives. Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to establish project deliverables, responsibilities, timelines, and implementation requirements. Engineering Design and Technical Evaluation Review engineering designs, drawings, technical specifications, calculations, and other project documentation to ensure compliance with applicable standards and project requirements. Evaluate proposed equipment upgrades, system modifications, and engineering solutions for technical feasibility, safety, reliability, and operational compatibility. Provide engineering recommendations for plant modifications, facility improvements, and equipment enhancement initiatives. Coordinate technical reviews with internal engineering teams, consultants, contractors, and equipment suppliers. Ensure that proposed engineering solutions consider existing plant configurations, operational constraints, and long-term asset requirements. Project Execution and Implementation Lead and coordinate the implementation of assigned special engineering projects from initiation through completion and handover. Monitor project progress against approved schedules, budgets, technical specifications, and established performance requirements. Coordinate contractors, suppliers, technical personnel, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely and effective project execution. Conduct regular site inspections and progress assessments to verify compliance with approved plans, engineering standards, and quality requirements. Identify project risks, implementation challenges, and potential delays, and recommend appropriate corrective actions. Ensure that project activities are properly coordinated with ongoing plant operations to minimize operational disruptions. Project Cost, Schedule, and Quality Management Monitor project expenditures and resource utilization to ensure alignment with approved budgets and cost estimates. Review contractor quotations, technical proposals, bill of quantities, progress claims, and other project-related commercial documents. Track project milestones, deliverables, and implementation schedules and provide regular progress updates. Ensure that completed works comply with approved engineering designs, technical specifications, and quality standards. Evaluate variations, additional work requirements, and scope changes in coordination with relevant stakeholders. Maintain accurate records of project costs, schedules, technical changes, and implementation status. Testing, Commissioning, and Project Handover Coordinate inspection, testing, commissioning, and acceptance activities for completed engineering works and equipment installations. Verify that implemented projects meet technical specifications, operational requirements, and applicable safety standards. Coordinate the resolution of punch-list items, technical deficiencies, and outstanding contractor deliverables. Ensure the completion and turnover of as-built drawings, operation and maintenance manuals, test reports, warranties, and other required technical documentation. Coordinate with Operations and Maintenance teams to ensure the proper integration and operational readiness of completed projects. Safety, Compliance, and Risk Management Ensure that project implementation activities comply with applicable engineering standards, company policies, environmental requirements, and occupational health and safety regulations. Identify and assess technical, operational, construction, and implementation risks associated with assigned projects. Coordinate with HSE personnel and relevant stakeholders to ensure that appropriate safety controls and work permits are in place. Monitor contractor compliance with site safety requirements and approved work procedures. Support technical inspections, audits, and compliance reviews related to project implementation. Reporting and Cross-Functional Coordination Prepare technical reports, project progress updates, cost summaries, and management presentations on assigned engineering projects. Maintain organized project documentation, including project plans, technical evaluations, approvals, progress reports, and completion records. Coordinate with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, HSE, and other relevant departments to facilitate project execution. Recommend process improvements and engineering solutions that support the continuous improvement of plant operations. Perform other related duties and responsibilities as may be assigned in support of the Company's O&M objectives. Qualifications Education Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Licensed Professional Engineer is preferred. Experience At least five (5) years of relevant experience in engineering project management, project engineering, plant engineering, or related technical functions. Demonstrated experience in planning, coordinating, and implementing engineering projects, equipment upgrades, system modifications, or facility improvement works. Experience in project scheduling, cost estimation, technical evaluation, contractor coordination, and project execution monitoring. Exposure to power generation, utilities, industrial facilities, infrastructure, or other asset-intensive environments is highly preferred. Experience in utility-scale solar PV facilities or renewable energy projects is an advantage. Other Qualifications Strong understanding of engineering design, technical specifications, project execution, and commissioning processes. Knowledge of project management principles, project scheduling, cost monitoring, and quality assurance. Familiarity with engineering tools and software such as AutoCAD, MS Project, Primavera P6, or similar applications. Ability to review technical drawings, engineering calculations, project proposals, and technical documentation. Working knowledge of occupational health and safety requirements and engineering standards applicable to project implementation. Strong project coordination, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams and external contractors. Willingness to work on-site in Gapan, Nueva Ecija and conduct field inspections as required.
